targets.authors: Alves, H., Koch, A., & Unkelbach, C.
targets.title: A cognitive-ecological explanation of intergroup biases
targets.evidence_quote: The datasets used were those made available by the authors, Alves et al. and are shared here again https://osf.io/vndky/ Exp1.dat contains the data to reproduce claim gdyrdr, whereas Exp3.dat contains the data used to reproduce claims b7dlq4, gzljvk, and ml3qr2.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: Completed claim(s): No claims were completed at the PBR stage, and all were completed at Analysis attempt 1.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: I therefore set up two alternative models with different estimators (ml and dwls) and was prepared to try various combinations to successfully reproduce the results. However, it turned out that the Alves et al. had used the default model provided here https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/mediation.html I copied the R-code and only replaced the variable names.
targets.outcome_reasoning: All four claim evaluations explicitly report reproduction and tabulate matching values after reconstructing the code and column order. Candidate alternative estimators were considered in order to recover the original specification; no substantive robustness analysis is reported.

reasoning: Primary completed Hanel report matches the assigned OSF project and article; bibliographic contributors in the assignment are project-level contributors. One original paper, with claims from Experiments 1 and 3, is reanalysed.
